snippet.title: ATHYRA - The Rock Paper Scissors Horror Game | Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
🪨✂️📄 ATHYRA: DEMO OUT NOW 📄✂️🪨
A psychological horror game... about Rock, Paper, Scissors.

Athyra takes Rock, Paper, Scissors and turns it into a psychological horror trial full of puzzles, jumpscares, and cryptic lore. Inspired by Inscryption and Buckshot Roulette, Athyra pits you against disturbing foes in deadly games of Rock, Paper, Scissors...

🎮 Play the free demo on Steam now!
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3645650/Athyra_Rock_Paper_Scissors/
